id: title:jurajmajerik:move hypothesis next to results cap content width

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a dedicated UI section for users to input and edit the experiment hypothesis, replacing the hypothesis section previously located in Info.tsx.
review.reason: This chunk represents a localized frontend change. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 demonstrate the removal of hypothesis-related state and UI from Info.tsx and the addition of a new Hypothesis component and modal. P1.F2.H3 adds a max-width wrapper. While the observations indicate a UI reorganization, the chunk explicitly lacks the backend implementation, database migration, and API changes.
review.uncertainty: This score is assigned because the implementation is bounded to the frontend and does not demonstrate the complete, systemic capability or backend support required for a Tier 2 or 3 assessment. The benefit relies on unverified backend support and database changes not present in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the backend implementation, database migration, or API changes required to support the hypothesis field. The frontend adds a UI and a modal, but without backend support, the saved description cannot be persisted. This chunk also does not include the snapshot hash changes, which are likely unrelated to the hypothesis feature and could be a separate change

observations.behavior: Adds a new Hypothesis component and its modal, while removing the hypothesis-related UI and state from Info.tsx. P1.F2.H3 adds a max-width wrapper to the tab content. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H2 update snapshot hashes.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a dedicated UI section for users to input and edit the experiment hypothesis, replacing the hypothesis section previously located in Info.tsx.

observations.behavior: Removes the hypothesis-related UI and state from Info.tsx, including the modal and its associated state and actions.
observations.posthog_connection: Reorganizes the layout of the Metrics tab, placing the new Hypothesis component alongside Exposures and MultiVariantBiasWarning.

observations.behavior: Adds a max-width wrapper to the tab content, potentially to prevent the tab content from expanding beyond a certain width.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the tab content rendering, potentially to prevent the tab content from expanding beyond a certain width.
